item.tib: mtha' bzhi gshen rgyud kyi rnam thar
item.coloph: mtha' bzhi'i gshen rgyud dri med zang ma 'di/ rnam thar gsum gyi go don mdor bdus nas/ 'dul seng bdag gis dkar chag zur tsam btab/ 'gal 'khrul sdebs nyes don log ci mchis pa/ yab mes rigs (rig) 'dzin rnams la bshags pa 'bul/ gzhan dang ma 'chol bon rgyud rim pa 'di/ dus mtha'i bar du gzhan gyis ma chod par/ gshen rgyud 'di yis rang gzhan don byed shog/
